title: Time Hotel.
content: I have to be honest.. I stopped watching television many years ago but a post I came across earlier mentioned the 2024 Christmas ep. of "Dr. Who". from what I gathered "Starseeds" are at the root of the story and mentioning a 'Time Hotel' got me intrigued. as I said, I don't do TV anymore, if I can avoid it, specifically that 'good old auntie!' the BBC. did anyone here make a similar connection from a MallWorld perspective? I could be persuaded to catch up in a kind of self flagatorial experiment but I would prefer a broader insight, before I decide it's worth the torture. 'SPOILERS' please.
